title: Work IQ: human in the loop for agents and agent flows

reasons: published before the check existed: kept live with a notice while a corrected version is prepared

summary: Hold: the assertion that Copilot Studio approval prompts cannot be mandated centrally is not established by Microsoft documentation. The roadmap details and both navigation paths are supported, but Microsoft's pages disagree about the default for Work IQ write operations and that disagreement needs to be disclosed.

claims.claim: Licensing specific to the new Work IQ pause and approval capability has not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop approval timeout identity requests pricing licensing. Read Work IQ in Copilot Studio and search excerpts for Work IQ API overview and Plan licensing and cost; these explain general billing, not this capability's licensing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes and cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Work IQ in Copilot Studio uses consumption billing with Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Work IQ in Copilot Studio is powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, which uses Copilot Credits for usage-based billing.

claims.claim: Whether pauses or approvals themselves add cost is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop approval timeout identity requests pricing licensing. Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio; read Work IQ API overview and Plan licensing and cost search excerpts. No result specified a pause or human-approval charge.

claims.claim: Work IQ MCP policy settings are under Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools. ... In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP. ... On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: An API or command equivalent for the Work IQ MCP tenant policy switch is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ MCP" policy configuration API PowerShell tenant settings. Opened MCP policy governance; read MCP overview and tool reference excerpts. General developer considerations give no configuration endpoint, cmdlet or executable policy-switch call.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls: first row and closing paragraph
claims.claim: Work IQ MCP mutation operations, including sending mail, are disallowed by default until administrators enable them.
claims.quote: By default, mutation operations aren't allowed for safety. This restriction includes create, update, delete, and action requests that modify data, such as sending email.
claims.fix: Attribute this default specifically to the MCP policy governance article and disclose the conflicting cited page: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/add-work-iq says 'Write operations are on by default.' Tell readers to verify their tenant's effective policy rather than treating read-only as a universal default.

claims.where: controls[0].governs and scope; Governance controls: first row
claims.claim: Administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off at tenant scope.
claims.quote: In the initial release, Work IQ MCP provides tenant-level policy control. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, tenant administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off for the tenant.

claims.claim: The tool confirmation option is at Copilot Studio > Tools > tool > Details > Additional details > Ask the end user before running.
claims.quote: Go to the Tools page for your agent, and select the tool from the list of tools. ... Details ... Additional details ... Ask the end user before running

claims.claim: An API or automation equivalent for the Copilot Studio tool confirmation setting is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Ask the end user before running" API configuration YAML approval admin centrally require; Copilot Studio tool confirmation YAML requires user confirmation setting API. Opened Add tools to custom agents; results about plugin annotations cover different controls.

claims.where: controls[1].governs, scope and note; What's changing; Governance controls: closing paragraph
claims.claim: Copilot Studio separately provides a maker-configured, per-tool option to ask the end user for confirmation before running a tool.
claims.quote: Ask the end user before running: In the end user chat experience, ask the agent for confirmation before running the tool. This option is set to No by default.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio approval prompts cannot be mandated centrally.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/add-tools-custom-agent instead of relying on another wiki briefing as evidence.
